readMe.startBody: We are excited to have you onboard. This app is designed to help streamline your workflow, manage records, and enhance your productivity. Explore its powerful features below.

instructions.list2: Manage your records in the "Check Records" section. Customize columns and search efficiently.
instructions.list3: Remove unwanted data in the "Eraser" section.
instructions.list5: Switch between light and dark modes using the toggle in the sidebar.

instructions.list1: Upload: Seamlessly upload images and manage them.
instructions.list2: Record Management: Easily manage and customize your data columns, from material costs to suppliers.
instructions.list3: Real-time Chat Support: Get quick assistance through our chat feature.
instructions.list4: User Management: Control user roles and permissions effectively.
instructions.list5: Dark/Light Mode Toggle: Toggle between modes for a personalized experience.
